name: Differentiable Blinn-Phong Light Estimation
aliases: Differentiable Light Source Estimation via Blinn-Phong
definition: An inverse approach to estimate light source parameters L by minimizing the photometric error E between a rendered image I(G, M, L) and an observed image I*, using a differentiable rendering pipeline based on the Blinn-Phong model.
summary: Differentiable Blinn-Phong Light Estimation optimizes point light source parameters by minimizing photometric error, distinguishing itself by modeling 3D parallax unlike distant lighting approximations.
